title: Penthouse February 1995 Emma Nixon Robert Vesco Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, February 1995, original $5.00 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover and Pet: Emma Nixon.

Cover features: The U.S. vs. Robert Vesco - an assassin's account of the desperate manhunt; Rogue Feminists; Cosmic Cashflow - America's most unusual stock predictions; the best workout gear; office-pool politics.

Back cover: Absolut vodka ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
